items.name: Amanda De Santa
items.summary: Michael's estranged wife, spending his money and testing the marriage.

items.name: Dave Norton
items.summary: The agent who put Michael in witness protection and keeps pulling him back in.

items.name: Devin Weston
items.summary: A billionaire who treats the crew as disposable contractors.

items.name: Dr. Isiah Friedlander
items.summary: Michael's opportunistic psychiatrist, recordable as a collectible side objective.

items.name: Franklin Clinton
items.summary: A repo man from South Los Santos who wants a bigger life than gang politics allow.

items.name: Jimmy De Santa
items.summary: Michael's aimless son, obsessed with games and internet fame.

items.name: Lamar Davis
items.summary: Franklin's best friend, whose schemes constantly put them both in danger.

items.name: Lester Crest
items.summary: A reclusive hacker and strategist who plans the crew's heists.

items.name: Martin Madrazo
items.summary: A Mexican drug lord with a mansion in Vinewood Hills.

items.name: Michael De Santa
items.summary: A retired bank robber in witness protection whose midlife crisis drags him back into crime.

items.name: Molly Schultz
items.summary: Devin Weston's lawyer and fixer.

items.name: Patricia Madrazo
items.summary: Martin's wife, who leaves him for Trevor.

items.name: Ron Jakowski
items.summary: Trevor's paranoid radio-operator and business partner.

items.name: Simeon Yetarian
items.summary: A shady luxury car dealer who employs Franklin and Michael.

items.name: Steve Haines
items.summary: A publicity-hungry FIB agent who blackmails the crew into government jobs.

items.name: Stretch
items.summary: Lamar's former associate who betrays the crew.

items.name: Tracey De Santa
items.summary: Michael's daughter, chasing reality-TV fame.

items.name: Trevor Philips
items.summary: A violent, unpredictable career criminal running arms and drugs out of Sandy Shores.

items.name: Wade Hebert
items.summary: Trevor's loyal but simple-minded friend.
